summary: Read a positive integer N in the closed range from 1 to 10000. Line the integers up as N, then one less, continuing down until 1. Between neighbors, cycle the four operator stages product, quotient, plus, and minus. Handle every product and every quotient by scanning from the left side toward the right side before any plus or minus is applied. Quotient results round downward, and the worked sample of ten times nine over eight yields eleven. After that scan, apply plus and minus from the left side toward the right side as well. Write the final integer. It is guaranteed to fit in a signed 32-bit range.
notes: The left column is this sample's input text and the right column is the text the program should print. Comparison ignores trailing newlines.
